summary: Backend-only testing for Atelier Noir AI Fashion Design Studio (Django ASGI + pymongo + Gemini Nano Banana via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). 28/28 pytest test cases passed in 44s, covering health, auth (register/login/me + validation 400/401/409), design generation (with and without reference image, both returned base64 data-URI images), design list/detail/delete, collections CRUD + add/remove items + embedded designs, outfits CRUD + embedded designs, and 404 handling. Cleanup verified with create->get->delete->get(404) pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: views.py login() does not strip _id from password_hash lookup (it does via projection {"_id":0}) — OK; but verify_password runs even when user is None could throw — current code short-circuits with `not user or ...` — OK.
generate_design accepts up to 20MB reference images and base64-encodes synchronously in the request thread; consider streaming or background processing for production.
MongoDB writes don't index user_id/id; for scale add compound indexes on (user_id, id) and (user_id, created_at) on designs, collections, outfits.
JWT_SECRET in .env is the placeholder 'change-me' — flag for production hardening but acceptable for preview.
collection_add_item DELETE branch accepts JSON body for design_id — non-standard REST; works correctly in tests but consider using path param /items/<design_id> for DELETE.
list_designs returns the full base64 image inline for up to 200 designs — large payloads. Consider returning thumbnails or signed URLs and lazy-loading full image on detail.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own TEST_ prefixed designs, collections, and outfits. Seed test user is re-registered if not found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_api.py as regression suite. Gemini Nano Banana via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is live and responsive (~10-15s per generation). Both classes preserve created ids as class attrs (TestDesigns.no_ref_id, TestCollections.coll_id, TestOutfits.outfit_id) for downstream tests — keep class order intact. TestZCleanup runs last to delete created data; alphabetic class ordering matters.
